title: Model collection: load a directory of scans, browse, keep/reject
description: 'A way to load all of the models in the collection and store that they are a collection before merging' and 'pick and choose between various of the generated outputs.' A collection is a directory of GLBs with *.settings.json sidecars (the Trellis2 settings in ~/crawfish: backend, resolution, steps, seed, decimation_target, texture_size). ModelCatalog.collection(Path) scans it; the membership and per-member keep/reject decisions persist as a collection.dsl manifest in that directory (one `load_mesh` per member, an `input_boolean` keep flag per member, members joined nowhere yet -- the merge is CRAW-16), honouring the one-language ruling. Scene side: a COLLECTION section in the model menu lists members with their settings summary, cycles the active member (keys [ ]), toggles keep/reject (K), and shows kept count; `ixdar-cli list-meshes` prints collections and members. ModelChoice gains Kind.COLLECTION so -Dixdar.model=~/crawfish opens the collection. Related: VIEW-6 (staging dir + sync-models), VIEW-7 and VIEW-8 (sidebar model switcher / click-to-load model list) -- the collection section lives in that sidebar.
definition-of-done: 1. -Dixdar.model=/home/acw/crawfish loads the collection, shows 10 members with settings summaries, and displays the first. 2. [ / ] cycle members without re-running any computation; K toggles keep and writes collection.dsl. 3. collection.dsl re-executes with ValidateDsl and reflects keep flags. 4. `ixdar-cli list-meshes` and uiState expose collection members and keep flags. 5. Loading a 40 MB member takes under 5 s after the first (cache the parsed ArrayMesh per member, bounded by a member count). 6. Build checkstyle-green.
testing-plan: 1. Unit: ModelCatalog.collection on a temp dir with two tiny .gltf + settings.json -> two members, settings parsed. 2. Unit: manifest writer/reader round trip of keep flags. 3. run-scene mesh-viewer --property ixdar.model=/home/acw/crawfish --keep-alive; `key ]` x3; `ui-state` shows member index; `key K`; check collection.dsl on disk.
todos: ModelCatalog.collection scan + settings.json parsing into a CollectionMember value class
collection.dsl manifest writer/reader (load_mesh + input_boolean per member)
COLLECTION menu section, member cycling keys, keep toggle
unknowns: Whether members should be aligned to a common frame at load (scans from different photos are not registered) or only in CRAW-16
Whether keep/reject is per member or per labelled part of a member (the latter needs CRAW-6 and is deferred to CRAW-16)
